input: Research freight forwarding for my online shop

gold.taskTitle: Research freight forwarding for my online shop
gold.taskDescription: Understand and evaluate freight forwarding options suitable for the user's online shop.

questions.title: What types of products are you shipping?
questions.description: Understand the nature of the goods being shipped to identify relevant freight requirements.

questions.title: Which countries are you shipping from and to?
questions.description: Identify the origin and destination regions to narrow down relevant freight forwarders.

questions.title: What is your average shipment size or weight?
questions.description: Determine whether shipments are small parcels, pallets, or full container loads.

questions.title: How often do you need to ship orders each month?
questions.description: Gauge shipping volume and frequency to assess which service tiers are appropriate.

questions.title: Do you need air, sea, or road freight options?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred or required mode of transport based on cost and speed priorities.

questions.title: What is your main priority — cost, speed, or reliability?
questions.description: Identify the key decision-making criterion for selecting a freight forwarder.

questions.title: Have you already used any freight forwarders before?
questions.description: Find out if there is prior experience or existing relationships that provide a baseline for comparison.
